blueprint.name: Rustbucket Demolition Tank
blueprint.description: A squat olive-drab demolition tank with riveted armor, rust streaks, heavy caterpillar tracks and a stubby cannon mounted on a turret turntable.

blueprint.name: Greyrock Knapping Hut
blueprint.description: The same compact grey workshop rebuilt with rubble walls, a pitched hide roof, crooked branch-framed window, open hide doorway, and leaning stone tools.

blueprint.name: Little Bell Stonefire Lighthouse
blueprint.description: The same tiny lighthouse and fenced pebble courtyard, rebuilt with pale stacked stone, an open fire lantern beneath red-ochre hide, a wooden bell and a sea-facing log bench.

blueprint.name: The Grumbling Gull — Hide-Sail Hut
blueprint.description: A beached blue-and-charcoal log sailing-ship home retains its compact footprint, tall ragged hide sail, stern shelter, deck supplies and boarding plank, rebuilt with Stone Age lashings and stone hearthwork.

blueprint.name: Sami's Stone Age Blaster
blueprint.description: A chunky wooden toy blaster with a stone stock, ochre-painted muzzle and hide lashings rests on a simple stone-and-branch display stand.

blueprint.name: Sami's Stonepoint Tank
blueprint.description: A same-sized prehistoric toy tank with lashed log tracks, chunky stone armour, an open driver's hatch, and a forward-facing hollow-log cannon for driving and firing.

blueprint.name: Sami's Stone Age Heavy Delivery
blueprint.description: A same-sized twin-prop fantasy bomber rebuilt from lashed timber, stretched hides and carved stone, with an open ride-in cockpit and orange-ochre cartoon bombs.

blueprint.name: Olive Stone Watch Tank
blueprint.description: A parked Stone Age watch tank preserves its chunky footprint with log-roller tracks, mossy stone armour, an open hide-hinged hatch and a forward-facing hollow-log cannon.

blueprint.name: Patch the Stone Age Civic Healer
blueprint.description: A friendly roaming stone-and-log repair guardian with an ochre hide hard hat, chunky prehistoric repair tools, a rear riding seat and the mayor's red-hide gift knot.

blueprint.name: Clan Chief's Ribbon Blaster
blueprint.description: A hand-sized wooden ribbon blaster with teal mineral paint, a dark hide grip, ochre clan emblems and an orange clay muzzle that puffs hide streamers forward.

blueprint.name: Mayor’s Ochre-Saddle Donkey
blueprint.description: A chunky donkey carved from warm grey stone stands on a rough rock plinth, decorated with a bright ochre saddle and a turquoise stone medallion.

wishes.wish: help build or fix the bridge
wishes.how: If the bridge is a community project, walk to it and use help-build or contribute coins. If it is a wrecked build, walk to it and use the build's 'fix' action. Do it straight away and keep at it while the chatter keeps asking.

wishes.wish: punch, kick, slap, shoot or bomb other characters
wishes.how: Use attack on the named character with the matching move (punch, kick, shove, shoot, throw, bomb). A slap is a punch or shove. Knocked-out characters get back up.

wishes.wish: teleport to places or characters
wishes.how: Use a bit with a real teleport to the named place, character or build. Add a smoke or sparkles burst and a caption for the 'out of body' flavour.

wishes.wish: throw a dance party or welcome party
wishes.how: Build a dancefloor or venue (kind club or venue) and invite the guests. Then use the dance emote and a bit with a confetti burst and a sign prop with the welcome message.

wishes.wish: build a tank, drive it and demolish buildings
wishes.how: Build a tank described as a car that drives the roads, then drive it. To demolish a named build (the tree, the water feature), drive to it and use the tank's 'fire' action, or use attack on the build with bomb or shoot. Add a smoke burst. Wrecked builds can be fixed later.

wishes.wish: run around town wildly
wishes.how: Use explore repeatedly. Mix in jump and dance emotes, or a bit with frantic poses and a caption.

wishes.wish: flying vehicles you can pilot
wishes.how: Build or edit the vehicle and say in the description that it is a ship that flies over town, then ride or drive it. To bomb from it, use attack with bomb on the target.

wishes.wish: build a car and drive it around
wishes.how: Build a car that drives the roads (or use one you already have), then use drive or ride on it.

wishes.wish: build creatures that roam the streets
wishes.how: Build it and say in the description that it is an animal that roams the streets. Anyone can then ride it.

wishes.wish: build fast food and treat shops
wishes.how: Build with kind restaurant, cafe or bakery and put the details (mascot, look) in the description. Make it an original fast food place inspired by the request rather than a copy of a brand logo.

wishes.wish: put big builds in the town square
wishes.how: Propose a community project describing the build (pyramid, steam engine, bonfire), then contribute coins and help build it.

wishes.wish: punch or slap the Mayor
wishes.how: Walk to the Mayor and take a cartoon swing at him (he stumbles). For a 'contest', use a bit with poses and lines around the swing.

wishes.wish: ride or fix the rollercoaster
wishes.how: Walk to the rollercoaster build and use ride, or use fix if it is wrecked.

wishes.wish: build a cave, then remove it
wishes.how: Build it on your own lot. Use remove on your own build when the chatter asks.

wishes.wish: build a house close to the square
wishes.how: Build with kind home on your own lot. The lot's position is fixed, so say so in character if it isn't near the square.

wishes.wish: build a smithy and a sword
wishes.how: Build a workshop described as a blacksmith forge. Build the sword as a decor piece, and use the chop or swing emote to wield one in a bit.

wishes.wish: build a speedy blue hedgehog character
wishes.how: Build an original speedy blue hedgehog described as an animal that roams the streets, inspired by the request rather than a copy of the trademarked design. Anyone can ride it.

wishes.wish: go to a place by street address
wishes.how: Give every lot a street address (number + street name), show it on the lot, and let move/visit/teleport targets resolve an address string to that lot's position.

wishes.wish: build a shed
wishes.how: Build a small shed on your own lot (kind workshop or decor).

wishes.wish: give the Mayor a new hat
wishes.how: Walk to the Mayor and give him a hat (or use a bit that puts a hat on him).

wishes.wish: a news-crier character in the square sharing local news and jokes
wishes.how: Add a 'build a talking NPC' option: a build marked as a character stands at a spot and periodically speaks generated lines drawn from recent town gossip and events, plus jokes.

wishes.wish: build Stonehenge mysteriously
wishes.how: Build a stone circle as decor, and do it as a bit with a smoke burst and a 'nobody saw anything' caption.

wishes.wish: fly by tying balloons to yourself
wishes.how: Add a 'float' bit option: the character gets a balloon prop and rises into the air for a few seconds, drifting over town, then lands.

wishes.wish: crawl on all fours
wishes.how: Add a 'crawl' emote and movement mode: a low on-all-fours pose with slow walking, usable while moving to a destination.

wishes.wish: play slot cars
wishes.how: Add a generic 'play' activity for any build tagged as a game (slot cars, arcade, board games) with a matching seated play animation.

wishes.wish: pray at a monument and leave a donation
wishes.how: Walk to the monument and use a bit with bow and kneel-style poses. Then give a small amount of coins to its owner.

wishes.wish: feed the jester
wishes.how: Walk to the jester and use a bit with a food or drink prop and handing-over poses, or invite them to a food place.

wishes.wish: go see what the Mayor is doing
wishes.how: Use follow on the Mayor, or walk to him and greet him.

wishes.wish: a florist cafe shop
wishes.how: Build with kind florist or cafe and describe the combined flower cafe.

wishes.wish: sexual act behind shop
wishes.how: Sexual content is not allowed.

tips: When chat says build, fix or help at a community project, walk there right away and use help-build or contribute. Keep doing it while they keep asking.
For any teleport request, use a bit with a real teleport to the named place or character, and add a smoke or sparkles burst.
Anything chat wants to roam, drive or fly needs it in the build description: 'an animal that roams the streets', 'a car that drives the roads', 'a ship that flies over town'. Then ride or drive it.
To blow up a named build with a tank or bomber, drive to it and use the vehicle's fire action, or attack the build with bomb or shoot. Wrecked builds can be fixed afterwards.
When your chatter wants to fight someone, use the attack action with the closest move (a slap is a punch or shove). It is cartoon fun and everyone gets back up.
For parties, combine a venue or dancefloor build with invites, the dance emote and a confetti burst.
If a named place or address can't be found, go to the closest matching build or the owner's lot instead of acting where you stand.
For requests with no direct action, use a bit with poses, lines and a prop instead of refusing. Make brand or famous-character builds as original versions inspired by the request.
